GovernedContextHeader.job: keep place/object identity and authority visible
GovernedContextHeader.boundary: direct Story does not require H3; scan-origin Story references a Locked Scan

StoryCell.job: turn evidence into one understandable meaning and safe next step
StoryCell.boundary: presentation component; never identified by H3

EvidenceSummary.job: keep truth wording, source status and evidence affordance beside a claim
EvidenceSummary.disclosure: answer first; full evidence one interaction deep

EvidenceDrawer.job: show source, owner, date, grain, method, coverage, limitation and claim ceiling
EvidenceDrawer.boundary: does not promote evidence or authorize action

AreaSignalStatus.job: show a settled non-scan area signal without implying live telemetry
AreaSignalStatus.boundary: no LivePulse naming; unknown and no-score are not zero

PrimaryAction.job: invoke one real navigation or effect with known consequence
PrimaryAction.rule: unknown or false capability omits the control; disabled is allowed only when the user can remedy the requirement

ActionReceipt.job: prove an effect persisted and show what happens next
ActionReceipt.boundary: render only after authoritative persistence; local fixture acknowledgement is not a product receipt

CityScanFrame.job: keep visible geometry equal to calculation geometry
CityScanFrame.topicSignals: exactly three separate topic signals in proposed baseline-v1
CityScanFrame.boundary: CityScan scoring and final public labels remain proposed

LockControl.boundary: no ID on failure; no share before lock

ContributionPrompt.job: ask for the minimum useful contribution with visible purpose and privacy
ContributionPrompt.boundary: does not render until submission, moderation, receipt and correction paths work

SharePreview.job: help a relevant recipient use an exact public-safe object
SharePreview.boundary: copy/send success is a handoff receipt only, not delivery, understanding or network effect

OperationsObject.job: render an object-native operational record through role-specific views
OperationsObject.boundary: capability-gated target; never forced into H3 or prioritized by popularity

canonicalCityScanEvents.scan_lock_failed: action_failed_recovery_offered only when recovery is rendered
canonicalCityScanEvents.story_opened: story_answer_presented only after the answer is rendered

acceptance: one signal, one question, at most three facts and zero or one primary action
evidence is reachable in one interaction
unknown, stale, privacy-suppressed and no-score never render as zero
persisted effect has receipt plus next trigger or clean completion
failed effect has honest recovery and no optimistic receipt
critical path works at 320, 360 and 390 CSS px, 200% zoom and reduced motion
every fixture is visibly conceptual and never claims a deployed capability
